title: standards
description: ~/.ai-flow/<KEY>/standards.json — the resolved standards layering for one ticket, written by `standards resolve` and refreshed by `stage start` when the resolution hash moves. Stage-independent: one resolution covers every stage, and each section records the stages the budget dropped it from (dropped_from[]); guidance.md is the per-stage rendering of this same resolution.

resolution_hash.description: sha256 over (budget, languages, addons, pack identity, waivers). `standards resolve` is idempotent on this value.

sources.description: Every pack that contributed, in layer order (org, team, repo).

commit.description: The git commit this pack was synced at, "embedded" for the embedded reference pack, or empty for a local-path pack that has no commit.

fingerprint.description: sha256 over the pack tree's sorted path→content digests — what actually moves the resolution hash when pack content changes under a pinned ref.

tokens.description: config.standards.guidance_budget_tokens; 0 means unbudgeted (nothing is ever dropped).

per_stage.description: One entry per stage that has any applicable section, in pipeline order.

must_overflow_bytes.description: How far the must set alone exceeded the budget, in bytes. Nothing truncates a must; this records the overflow so guidance.md and doctor can report it.

sections.description: Every section from every layer, in (severity, layer, id) order. An entry with overridden_by set is shadowed by a more specific layer and contributes nothing; the effective set is the entries whose overridden_by is null.

overridden_by.description: The layer that replaced this entry, or null when this entry is the effective one.

override_reason.description: The reason the overriding manifest declared for replacing this entry, when it declared one.

conflict.description: Set on the entry that lost because it tried to replace a less specific must without an overrides[] declaration.

dropped_from.description: The stages the token budget dropped this section from.

checks.description: Every check from every layer, in (layer, id) order, with the same overridden_by shadowing rule as sections.

conflicts.description: Every resolve-time conflict, reported rather than failed: a more specific layer tried to replace a less specific must without declaring it.

waivers.description: Every waiver read from every in-scope repository's .ai-flow/waivers.json, expired ones included (an expired waiver re-fires, and is recorded here with expired: true).
